name: Sesame Salmon-Bell Pepper Skewers with Grilled Bok Choy & Rice

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 12-18 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 red bell peppers
9 baby bok choy

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a large bowl along with oil, soy sauce, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and large dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the marinade.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin.
Cut the salmon into 1-inch cubes. Add to the bowl, gently stir to coat, and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, using a clean cutting board, trim and cut bok choy in half lengthwise. Place on a platter, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, woking in batches, add bok choy, cut-side down, and grill, flipping once, until tender and charred, 4-5 minutes. Return to the platter and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, thread salmon and bell pepper onto the skewers, alternating ingredients; place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the salmon and bell pepper directly on the grill pan.)

Return pan to medium-high heat. Working in batches, add skewers and grill, turning every 1 ½-2 minutes, until salmon is opaque and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to the platter with the bok choy.
To serve, divide rice, bok choy, and skewers between plates. Sprinkle skewers with sesame seeds and enjoy!
